info.title: twblazor - scaffold a Blazor app with twblazor
info.description: Scaffold a Blazor Web App with twblazor and a dashboard, sidebar, navbar or blank layout.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install or update the templates only

options.name: --templates
options.description: Template folder or package id. Default: installed templates.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create an app from a template

options.name: --interactivity
options.description: Server, Wasm or Auto. Default: Server.

options.name: --template
options.description: dashboard, sidebar, navbar or blank. Default: dashboard.

options.name: --output
options.description: Folder to create the app in. Default: ./<name>.

options.name: --templates
options.description: Template folder or package id. Default: installed templates.

options.name: --no-npm
options.description: Skip npm install and the Tailwind CSS build.

options.name: --force
options.description: Write into a folder that is not empty.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Project and solution name, for example MyApp.
